name: Disk Usage
description: Show all drives with used/free space

name: Top Processes by CPU
description: Show top 10 processes by CPU usage
script: Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, @{N='CPU(s)';E={[math]::Round($_.CPU,1)}}, @{N='MemMB';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

name: Recent Event Log Errors
script: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System','Application'; Level=1,2} -MaxEvents 20 | Select-Object TimeCreated, LevelDisplayName, ProviderName, @{N='Msg';E={$_.Message.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(120,$_.Message.Length))}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

name: All Running Services
description: List all currently running Windows services
script: Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -eq 'Running'} | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, Status | Sort-Object Name | Format-Table -AutoSize

name: Check Pending Windows Updates
description: List available Windows updates without installing
script: $session = New-Object -ComObject Microsoft.Update.Session; $searcher = $session.CreateUpdateSearcher(); $found = $searcher.Search('IsInstalled=0 and Type=Software'); "Pending updates: $($found.Updates.Count)"; $found.Updates | ForEach-Object { $_.Title }

name: Restart a Windows Service
description: Restart a named service — edit script to set the service name
